text:
Silver Price in 1982
Among 12 monthly observations available for 1982, the LBMA silver price rose 31.3% between 1982-01-29 ($8.28) and 1982-12-31 ($10.87). The highest sampled price was $10.87 in December and the lowest was $5.73 in June. The mean of these observations was $7.93. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
